question: In the morning Ada unpacked 43 boxes of candles, 8 candles to a box, onto her market table, and then added 69 candles from her own workshop. In the afternoon she sold every candle on the table at 4 dollars each; the market ran for two hundred and forty minutes, four hours. In the evening she paid 1407 dollars out of that money for the month's stall rent. How many dollars did Ada have left from the day's candle money?

Sam's phone plan had 53 minutes of call time left. The provider added a 5-minute bonus, and then Sam used 10 minutes calling his aunt. He bought a 20-minute top-up and later used 20 minutes on a work call. Sam knows sixty minutes make an hour, but the plan counts in minutes. How many minutes of call time does Sam have left?

A teacher had 36 pencils, but 18 of them were broken and thrown away. She bought 44 new pencils and found 13 more in a cupboard after half an hour of tidying. She then shared all the pencils equally among the 5 tables in her classroom. How many pencils were put on the window table?

Rosa's bank account held 81 dollars. She paid 33 dollars for a phone bill, then deposited 40 dollars from a shift at the cafe. Her brother repaid 62 dollars he owed her, she sold an old lamp for 17 dollars, and her grandmother sent 15 dollars, all of which went into the account. Rosa tracks the account in dollars, though she knows a hundred cents make a dollar. How many dollars are in Rosa's account now?

A school library had 82 shelves with 9 books on each shelf. A dozen volunteers sorted 70 donated books onto the shelves, and a publisher sent 55 more. During the term 459 books were lent out, and 130 worn-out books were removed. The library opened 25 years ago. Each book still on the shelves is insured for 8 dollars. How many dollars is the insurance on the books still on the shelves?

At half past seven, 154 people were queuing outside the cinema, where tickets cost 9 dollars. The doors opened and 50 people went in, and then 78 people gave up and left. A bus dropped off 20 more people who joined the queue, and 5 latecomers arrived after them. Then 26 people were let in. How many people were still in the queue?

In the morning a caterer had 65 guests confirmed for a dinner, and 37 more confirmed by noon. In the afternoon 4 guests cancelled, and then 10 walk-ins were added to the list. The hall has 12 windows. In the evening every guest on the list paid 6 dollars for dessert, and one table left a 28-dollar tip; the dinner lasted one hundred and fifty minutes, two and a half hours. How many dollars did the caterer collect from desserts and the tip together?

Tia had 123 packets of sunflower seeds. She used 94 packets on the school garden and gave 20 packets to a neighbour, then bought 33 packets at the market. Each packet she has now holds 9 seeds, and she sowed every seed in her garden, which is 8 metres long. Every seed grew into a plant with 5 flower heads. How many flower heads did Tia's garden produce?

Nia had 166 stickers and gave 100 of them to her friend Ravi, who then had more stickers than Nia. She bought 26 stickers at the shop. Then she bought a matching sticker for every one she owned, so she had 2 of each. She used 32 stickers on her notebook and gave 73 to her little brother. How many stickers does Nia have now?

In the morning Jo had 45 sheets of stamps and used 17 whole sheets on a mailing. Each remaining sheet has 8 rows with 3 stamps in every row, and she peeled them all into her stamp tin. In the afternoon her aunt gave her 11 stamps for the tin. In the evening she found 25 more stamps in a drawer and added them too. How many stamps were in Jo's tin at the end of the evening?

Kim put 25 dollars into her savings jar every week for 7 weeks, then added 74 dollars from her birthday. Her grandfather then doubled whatever was in the jar. A month later her grandmother matched the jar too, so it held twice as much as before her gift. Finally Kim added 30 dollars from babysitting. How many dollars are in Kim's jar now?

In the morning a bike hire shop had 118 bikes in its rack. Before noon 71 bikes were hired out, and then 24 more. In the afternoon 10 bikes were returned, followed by 11 more. A day's hire costs 5 dollars. In the evening 69 bikes were returned. How many bikes were in the rack at the end of the evening?

Ria had 174 beads, but 27 were chipped and thrown away. She divided the rest equally into 3 jars and kept one jar. At the craft fair she traded every bead in her jar for 8 tiny seed beads each. She gave 20 seed beads to her cousin Sana. Then she split all her remaining seed beads equally among herself, Sana and Mo, so that Sana ended up with more seed beads than Ria. How many seed beads does Ria have?

Uma's flower farm has 89 rows, each row has 2 beds, each bed holds 5 plants, each plant has 4 stems, and each stem carries 9 blooms. The farm covers 12 hectares. This week Uma sold 22550 blooms to florists. Her rival Lev has fewer blooms left on his farm than Uma. How many blooms does Uma have left?

In the morning Tom set out 150 bags of oranges with 5 oranges in every bag, tipped into one big crate, and by noon he had sold 523 oranges to a dozen customers. In the afternoon a juice bar bought every orange left in the crate at 9 cents each. In the evening the juice bar's owner sent over a 23-cent tip. Tom's neighbour Eve took in less at her stall than Tom did from the juice bar. How many cents did Tom receive from the juice bar altogether?

A beekeeper's storeroom held 137 jars of honey. She added 3 jars from the last of the spring batch and 32 jars from the summer batch. Then 2 jars broke on the shelf, and she added 25 jars from a late batch. The storeroom is 4 metres wide. She sold every jar in the storeroom at 6 dollars each. How many dollars did she take in?

At half past six in the morning, a garden water butt held 39 litres. A morning shower added 77 litres, and an afternoon storm added another 77 litres. The gardener poured in 13 litres from a bucket, and a final drizzle added 34 litres. How many litres are in the water butt now?

Sami had 201 stamps and gave 92 of them to his friend Lia. At a stamp swap he doubled his collection, coming home with twice as many stamps as he had taken. His uncle then gave him 73 stamps and his teacher gave him 18. Sami then donated 236 stamps to the school club, so Lia now has more stamps than Sami. How many stamps does Sami have now?

In the morning a cafe had 82 cupcakes on the counter and sold 58 of them. In the afternoon 14 more were sold, and 4 were dropped and thrown away. In the evening the cupcakes still on the counter were shared equally among the 6 staff, including Mia and Jo. Jo had eaten more cupcakes during the day than Mia. How many cupcakes did Mia get in the evening?

A printer prepared a booklet from 124 large sheets. Each sheet was folded into 2 leaves, and each leaf carries 2 pages of text. He added 26 index pages to the booklet. The printer's shop has 3 presses. He printed 5 copies of the complete booklet, then split all the printed pages into 2 equal boxes and sent one box to the client. How many pages were in the box sent to the client?

Dina's orchard has 71 rows of 9 apple trees, and each tree gave 9 kilograms of apples this year. Her total harvest, once she added in the two orchards she rents, came to triple that amount. She sold 8116 kilograms to a juice factory and 1839 kilograms at the market. Her cousin Eko has fewer kilograms of apples left than Dina. How many kilograms of apples does Dina have left?

In the morning 41 students were in the drama club room. Before break 10 students left for a music lesson, and 17 left for sports practice. In the afternoon 24 students arrived for rehearsal, and 6 went home early. The room has 8 windows. In the evening every student still in the room was given 3 tickets for the show. How many tickets were given out?

Priya had 98 trading cards, while her cousin Marcus had only 61, so Priya's pile was clearly the bigger one. At a weekend fair Priya bought 39 more cards, and a friend then gave her another 9. Later she sold 96 of her cards to a dealer. In the club tournament, every card a player still holds scores 3 points per round, and the tournament ran for 6 rounds. How many points did Priya's cards score in total over the tournament?

In the morning, Rosa's jam company loaded 72 crates onto each of its 8 delivery trucks, and every crate held 9 jars of jam. In the afternoon all of the jars were repacked at the market into gift boxes of 6 jars each. Each gift box sold for 8 dollars, and every box was sold; the market's card reader reports takings in cents, so Rosa converted the total into dollars before writing it down. In the evening she paid 3388 dollars for the day's fuel, rent and wages out of those takings. How many dollars did Rosa have left from the day's takings after paying those costs?

Early in the morning, Hana's flower stall had 64 tulips. A delivery brought 38 more tulips, and she cut 4 more from her own garden. In the afternoon she sold every tulip she had at 9 dollars each. In the evening a regular customer handed her a 40-dollar tip on top of her sales. How many dollars did Hana take in that day, including the tip?
